title: 'Good companies go bad it seems as much due to the rules, as the rulers'
summary: Johnston ran a book club on it at Sanders Place with people working in climate, health, government and First Nations organisations. He picks out the biotech sold to Philip Morris over a fifteen-pence premium and the five years Patagonia spent on lawyers to put its mission in its charter.
blockquote: Good companies go bad it seems as much due to the rules, as the rulers.
